arguments.command:
OUT=/workspace/tmp/replay_run
cat $OUT/normal.stdout; echo ---; cat $OUT/boundary.stdout; echo ---; cat $OUT/invalid.stderr; echo ---; cat $OUT/comp2.stdout; echo ---
python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, re
OUT='/workspace/tmp/replay_run'
def xml(p):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
        return z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8'), z.namelist()
x,names = xml(OUT+'/minutes_formatted.docx')
print('normal checks:')
for probe in ['w:eastAsia="\u6977\u4f53"','w:ascii="Times New Roman"','w:line="360"','w:firstLineChars="200"','广州项目当前核心困境','外资大股东SC收回管理权后未推进建设','备注：本纪要系录音转写归纳']:
    print(' ', probe in x, probe)
print('  star-marker residue in text:', bool(re.search(r'<w:t[^>]*>[^<]*\*', x)))
x2,_ = xml(OUT+'/boundary_formatted.docx')
print('boundary checks:')
print('  heading sz 32 kept:', 'w:val="32"' in x2)
print('  body sz 24 applied:', 'w:val="24"' in x2)
print('  firstLineChars 200 present:', 'w:firstLineChars="200"' in x2)
print('  eastAsia kaiti:', 'w:eastAsia="\u6977\u4f53"' in x2)
# verify heading paragraph itself not indented: parse paragraphs
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT+'/boundary_formatted.docx') as z:
    d = z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
heads = re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', d, re.S)
for p in heads:
    if 'Heading1' in p or 'w:pStyle' in p:
        print('  heading para has firstLineChars:', 'firstLineChars' in p)
# text of star-only paragraph
print('  texts:', re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', d))
x3,_ = xml(OUT+'/step2_songti.docx')
print('composition step2 checks:')
print('  eastAsia songti:', 'w:eastAsia="\u5b8b\u4f53"' in x3)
print('  content kept 广州项目当前核心困境:', '广州项目当前核心困境' in x3)
print('zip members sample:', names[:5])
EOF
